password-storage-oauth.code: const crypto=require('node:crypto');function hash(pw,salt){return crypto.pbkdf2Sync(pw,salt,600000,32,'sha256').toString('hex')}function verify(pw,salt,expected){const actual=Buffer.from(hash(pw,salt),'hex'),wanted=Buffer.from(expected,'hex');return actual.length===wanted.length&&crypto.timingSafeEqual(actual,wanted)}const A={salt:'aaaa',pw:'hunter2'},B={salt:'bbbb',pw:'hunter2'},hA=hash(A.pw,A.salt),hB=hash(B.pw,B.salt);console.log('same password, same hash?',hA===hB);console.log('verify correct:',verify('hunter2',A.salt,hA));console.log('verify wrong:',verify('letmein',A.salt,hA));

stripe-object-model.code: const products={prod_pro:{name:'Pro plan'}},prices={price_m:{product:'prod_pro',unit_amount:1500,interval:'month'},price_y:{product:'prod_pro',unit_amount:18000,interval:'year'},price_bad:{product:'prod_missing',unit_amount:999,interval:'month'}},subs={sub_1:{customer:'cus_1',price:'price_y'},sub_2:{customer:'cus_2',price:'price_bad'}};function monthly(id){const price=prices[subs[id].price],product=products[price.product];if(!product)return{error:'price points at unknown product'};return{plan:product.name,cents:price.interval==='year'?price.unit_amount/12:price.unit_amount}}for(const id of ['sub_1','sub_2']){const r=monthly(id);console.log(id+':',r.error?'ERROR '+r.error:r.plan+' '+r.cents+'c/mo')}

hosted-checkout.code: const prices={price_once:{type:'one_time'},price_sub:{type:'recurring'}};function build(id){return{mode:prices[id].type==='recurring'?'subscription':'payment',line_items:[{price:id,quantity:1}],success_url:'https://example.test/success',cancel_url:'https://example.test/cancel'}}function validate(p,type){const expected=type==='recurring'?'subscription':'payment';return p.mode===expected?'':type+' price requires mode '+expected}for(const id of ['price_once','price_sub']){const p=build(id),err=validate(p,prices[id].type);console.log(id,'mode:',p.mode,'error:',err||'none')}console.log('wrong:',validate({mode:'payment'},'recurring')||'none');

webhooks-source-of-truth.code: const granted=[];function handle(event){const id=event.data.object.id;if(event.type==='checkout.session.completed')granted.push('grant:'+id);if(event.type==='invoice.payment_succeeded')granted.push('extend:'+id);return{status:200}}const events=[{type:'redirect',data:{object:{id:'sess_x'}}},{type:'checkout.session.completed',data:{object:{id:'sess_1'}}},{type:'invoice.payment_succeeded',data:{object:{id:'in_1'}}},{type:'customer.subscription.updated',data:{object:{id:'sub_1'}}}];for(const e of events)console.log(e.type,'->','ack '+handle(e).status);console.log('granted:',granted.join(',')||'none');

idempotent-handlers.code: const processed=new Set(),grants=[];function handle(event){if(processed.has(event.id))return{status:200,did:'skipped duplicate'};processed.add(event.id);grants.push(event.id);return{status:200,did:'processed'}}const stream=[{id:'evt_1'},{id:'evt_1'},{id:'evt_2'},{id:'evt_1'}];for(const e of stream)console.log(e.id,'->',handle(e).did);console.log('distinct grants:',grants.length);

capstone-signup-pay-access.code: const crypto=require('node:crypto'),secret='whsec_capstone',PLAN_FEATURES={pro:['basic','export']},ACCESS=new Set(['active','trialing']),processed=new Set();let state={plan:null,status:'none'};const hmac=(raw,t)=>crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(t+'.'+raw).digest('hex');function equalHex(a,b){if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(b))return false;const x=Buffer.from(a,'hex'),y=Buffer.from(b,'hex');return x.length===y.length&&crypto.timingSafeEqual(x,y)}function unlock(raw,header,feature,now,authed,tolerance){if(!authed)return{access:false,why:'unauthenticated'};const parts=Object.fromEntries(header.split(',').map(kv=>kv.split('='))),ts=Number(parts.t);if(!Number.isFinite(ts)||Math.abs(now-ts)>tolerance)return{access:false,why:'stale event'};if(!equalHex(hmac(raw,ts),parts.v1??''))return{access:false,why:'bad signature'};const evt=JSON.parse(raw);if(!processed.has(evt.id)){processed.add(evt.id);state={plan:evt.plan,status:evt.status}}const ok=ACCESS.has(state.status)&&(PLAN_FEATURES[state.plan]??[]).includes(feature);return{access:ok,why:ok?'granted':'denied'}}const t=1700000000,body=JSON.stringify({id:'evt_1',plan:'pro',status:'active'}),header='t='+t+',v1='+hmac(body,t);console.log('genuine:',unlock(body,header,'export',t+5,true,300).access);console.log('replay:',unlock(body,header,'export',t+6,true,300).access);console.log('forged:',unlock(body,'t='+t+',v1=deadbeef','export',t+7,true,300).access);console.log('stale:',unlock(body,header,'export',t+9999,true,300).access);console.log('applied count:',processed.size);
